**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

A clear and concise description of what tool, preset, or behavior you want to happen.

**Can this feature run entirely on-device in the browser?**
- [ ] Yes, this feature can be implemented using client-side JavaScript / Web Workers / Canvas / WebAssembly without requiring server uploads.
- [ ] Unsure.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockup sketches, or screenshots about the feature request here.
